billing_code_sets.description: Crohn's disease [regional enteritis] [active Crohn's disease with listed manifestations]
Rheumatoid arthritis [moderately to severely active in adults] [age 18 and older]

Adverse effect of immune checkpoint inhibitors and immunostimulant drugs [inflammatory arthritis]

request_routes.label: Adalimumab and biosimilars (medical)
request_routes.routing_notes: Initial and continuation coverage is permitted for adalimumab and approved biosimilars for the inflammatory indications described in Section II; other uses are considered investigational.
request_routes.evidence: Aetna considers adalimumab and its biosimilars medically necessary for the indications in Section II when the listed criteria are met and continuation criteria in Section III are satisfied.

route_guards.label: Document negative tuberculosis screening before initiating therapy in biologic/targeted synthetic naive members
route_guards.evidence: For all indications: Member has had a documented negative tuberculosis (TB) test within 12 months of initiating therapy if naïve to biologic or targeted synthetic drugs; if the screening test is positive, further testing must confirm no active disease before starting therapy.

route_guards.label: Confirm adalimumab is not being used concurrently with another biologic or targeted synthetic for the same indication
route_guards.evidence: For all indications: Member cannot use the requested medication concomitantly with any other biologic drug or targeted synthetic drug for the same indication.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis (adult)
condition_clusters.evidence: For adult members who previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic for moderately to severely active RA within the past 120 days, or for those with moderately to severely active RA who meet the biomarker and conventional therapy failure/intolerance requirements.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Moderate to severely active articular juvenile idiopathic arthritis (age 2+)
condition_clusters.evidence: For members 2 years or older who previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic for moderately to severely active articular JIA, or for those with moderate to severe disease who failed methotrexate/conventional synthetic therapy or have NSAID/glucocorticoid-refractory disease with high-risk prognostic features.

For adult members with active psoriatic arthritis who previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic drug, or for mild to moderate disease with therapy failure/intolerance or enthesitis/axial involvement, or for severe disease meeting the listed criteria.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Active ankylosing spondylitis or non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (adult)
condition_clusters.evidence: For adult members who previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic agent for AS or nr-axSpA, or for those with active disease who failed or could not tolerate at least two NSAIDs.

section_path: D. Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA)

condition_clusters.condition_label: Moderately to severely active Crohn's disease
condition_clusters.evidence: For treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis
condition_clusters.evidence: For treatment of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis.

For adult members with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis when crucial body areas are affected, significant BSA involvement is present, or when prior phototherapy/pharmacologic therapy failed or is contraindicated.

For members 12 years and older with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa who have had an inadequate response to a 90-day oral antibiotic trial or who have intolerance or contraindication to those antibiotics.

For members 2 years and older with non-infectious intermediate, posterior, and panuveitis who either failed corticosteroids/immunosuppressive therapy or have intolerance/contraindication to those therapies.

section_path: I. Uveitis (non-infectious intermediate, posterior and panuveitis)

condition_clusters.evidence: For members with Behcet’s disease who previously received apremilast or a biologic for Behcet’s, or who had an inadequate response to at least one non-biologic Behcet’s medication.
For treatment of pyoderma gangrenosum when the member has had an inadequate response to corticosteroids or immunosuppressive therapy or cannot tolerate those therapies.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-related toxicity (moderate or severe inflammatory arthritis)
condition_clusters.evidence: For treatment of immune checkpoint inhibitor-related toxicity when the member has moderate or severe immunotherapy-related inflammatory arthritis and failed or is intolerant to corticosteroids or a conventional synthetic drug.

Continuation is considered medically necessary for adult members who are using adalimumab for moderately to severely active RA and who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with at least 20% improvement from baseline in tender joint count, swollen joint count, pain, or disability.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continued therapy for articular juvenile idiopathic arthritis
condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is considered medically necessary for members 2 years of age or older using adalimumab for moderately to severely active articular JIA when there is low disease activity or improvement in active joints, loss of motion, or functional ability.

Continuation is medically necessary for adult members using adalimumab for psoriatic arthritis who achieve or maintain low disease activity or improvement in swollen/tender joints, dactylitis, enthesitis, axial disease, skin/nail involvement, functional status, or CRP.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continued therapy for ankylosing spondylitis and nr-axSpA
condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is medically necessary for adult members using adalimumab for ankylosing spondylitis or nr-axSpA who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response evidenced by low disease activity or improvements in functional status, spinal pain, inflammation, joint counts, or CRP.

section_path: D. Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA)

condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for moderately to severely active Crohn's disease who achieve or maintain remission or who demonstrate improvement in abdominal pain/tenderness, diarrhea, body weight, abdominal mass, hematocrit, mucosal appearance, or disease activity scoring tools.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for moderately to severely active UC who achieve or maintain remission or who improve in stool frequency, rectal bleeding, urgency, CRP, fecal calprotectin, mucosal appearance, or disease activity scoring tools.

Continuation is medically necessary for adult members using adalimumab for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who achieve or maintain low disease activity or improvement in BSA or psoriatic signs/symptoms.

Continuation is medically necessary for members 12 years and older using adalimumab for moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with reductions in abscess/nodule count, sinus tract/scarring formation, lesion frequency, pain, suppuration, relapses, quality of life, or disease severity scores.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continued therapy for non-infectious intermediate, posterior, and panuveitis
condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is medically necessary for members 2 years and older using adalimumab for non-infectious uveitis who achieve or maintain low disease activity as evidenced by reduced flares, stability or improvement in AC cell grade, vitreous haze, visual acuity, glucocorticoid requirements, and lack of new active lesions.

section_path: I. Uveitis (non-infectious intermediate, posterior and panuveitis)

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continued therapy for immune checkpoint inhibitor-related toxicity
condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for immunotherapy-related inflammatory arthritis who achieve or maintain low disease activity or improvement in signs and symptoms.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for other Section II indications (including Behcet’s disease) who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with low disease activity or improved signs and symptoms.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for other Section II conditions (such as pyoderma gangrenosum) who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with low disease activity or improved signs and symptoms.
